title: Independent bounded wording review: Wolof, Kinyarwanda, Māori P0/P1 gaps
reviewer: Independent model linguistic reviewer; no native-speaker certification
source_commit_provenance: Supplied PR #242 production baseline; no new remote verification during this original review. Five exact local resource/manifest hashes matched the draft and were unchanged during that review.
scope: All 33 submitted missing direct entries: 11 per locale, 5 P0 plus 6 P1 each. No existing translations were rewritten or independently certified.

decision_meanings.accepted_unchanged: Submitted wording accepted unchanged in this bounded independent review.
decision_meanings.corrected: Exact replacement supplied and accepted as this reviewer’s bounded wording recommendation.
decision_meanings.held: Neither original nor candidate accepted for integration; exact candidate is provided for the specific unresolved wording decision.

limits: No production or index changes, GitHub writes, new repository tests, builds, CI or runtime checks were performed in this original review.
No native-speaker certification. Confidence and material unresolved wording uncertainty are explicit.
No UI-fit, TalkBack, truncation, or visual-legibility claim. Full swatch labels and descriptive mode/fit labels remain unmeasured.
XML parsing, Unicode, placeholder, ellipsis and key-completeness checks below are review-artifact checks, not Android compilation or application test results.
A short lexical reference check supplemented independent language judgment. Existing strings are terminology context, not accepted evidence of their correctness.

lexical_reference_notes.use: Primary dictionary senses support the Insert-image ambiguity, not a complete UI translation.
Primary dictionary supports tirohanga as view.
Indexed primary lexicon result supports topa as zoom/zoom tool. Direct page open returned HTTP 403; no full-page access or sentence certification claimed.

rows.original_proposed_display: Aratau whakawhāiti matimati me te nuku i te tirohanga
rows.original_proposed_raw_xml: <string name="ui_pinch_and_pan_mode">"Aratau whakawhāiti matimati me te nuku i te tirohanga"</string>
rows.reviewed_display: Aratau mō te topa mā ngā matimati e rua me te nuku i te tirohanga
rows.reviewed_raw_xml: <string name="ui_pinch_and_pan_mode">"Aratau mō te topa mā ngā matimati e rua me te nuku i te tirohanga"</string>
rows.reviewed_backtranslation: Mode for zooming with two fingers and moving the view.
rows.rationale: Name zoom explicitly with topa and the two-finger interaction, then retain panning as nuku i te tirohanga. The draft only named narrowing the fingers and did not clearly state the zoom operation. The replacement covers zoom in/out without presenting image-pixel movement as the pan operation.
rows.remaining_uncertainty: Two-finger zoom is a functional description of pinch zoom, not a literal squeeze term. The indexed primary terminology evidence supports topa only; it does not certify this whole sentence or its UI fit.
